messages:
deploy-bot: Promo to release/2026-03-30 paused: ci-staging artifact restore failed (cache restore checksum mismatch) — holding auto-promote. https://ci.internal/runs/12884

alex: which artifact?

deploy-bot: redwood-telemetry-0.6.4.whl expected=8d9f2c1a actual=ef3b7a44
tori: paste tail of fetch log pls

alex: snippet:
```
GET /cache/cdn/redwood-telemetry-0.6.4.whl 200
stream copy failed: checksum mismatch
expected=8d9f2c1a... actual=ef3b7a44...
cdn edge returned truncated body
```

infra-sam: our CDN reported a partial object for that prefix during a re-replication job 02:15 UTC. Looks like one edge returned truncated bytes to puller.
sre-kai: change window closes in ~30m. Options: 1) abort promo and wait for CDN repair (delay release) 2) pin release to last-known-good digest and promote, then rebuild+reupload. Thoughts?
tori: pin+promote if we've got a verified digest archived. We should avoid schedule slips for downstream teams.
alex: found archived digest: archive://artifacts/8d9f2c1a.whl sha256=8d9f2c1a. Also have the source commit hash in metadata.
sre-kai: if we pin, need an incident, rollback steps, and a post-promo smoke eval. Also run wheel-inspect to ensure package contents match the expected commit.
infra-sam: dry-run promote command:
```bash
deploybot promote --release release/2026-03-30 --artifact redwood-telemetry==0.6.4 --digest 8d9f2c1a --force-pin --dry-run
```

infra-sam: dry-run OK. executing real promote now.
deploy-bot: Promote accepted: release pinned to digest 8d9f2c1a. Auto-promo resumed. Promotion complete.
tori: created INC-2026-254 (cdn-edge-truncation) assigned to infra-cdn. Release notes updated: "Pinned redwood-telemetry 0.6.4 to verified artifact digest due to cache restore checksum mismatch; rebuild+cdn re-replication scheduled."
alex: added rollback snippet to incident: how to unpin and re-promote when new digest available. Will run smoke eval and post results.
sre-kai: marking thread resolved from release perspective. Incident remains open for RCA and CDN fix.
